subject: Request: Senior ratification for Hosted API concessions and term change - MedTech AI
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Senior ratification for Hosted API concessions and term change - MedTech AI

Ben / Karthik —

We have a one-off ask from MedTech AI that requires senior signoff. Summary below and attached materials in Drive + the proposal PDF.

Quick facts:
- Customer: MedTech AI (enterprise imaging workflows)
- Seat / product: Hosted API (text + embeddings for diagnostic search)
- Baseline list rate: $0.0006/token (standard plan)
- Ask: net effective discount of 25% off list for 12 months, plus waiver of the usual 2% surcharge for cross-region egress during onboarding.
- Commit: 24M token monthly minimum ramping to 10B/month by month 6; expected ARR (first 12 months) ~ $1.8M after discount.
- Non-standard terms requested: shorter termination notice (30 days vs standard 60), and a data-residency addendum limiting storage to us-west-2 for the first 12 months.

Why we should consider it:
- Strategic vertical (imaging) with strong reference potential and partner introductions to three regional health systems.
- Large volume commitment with predictable ramp; ops has confirmed capacity for our Dedicated pools but this would start on Hosted initially.
- Legal flags are limited: they want clause tweaks but have agreed to scoped audit rights only.

Risk:
- The discount exceeds our standard 20% sales manager limit. Combined with termination and surcharge waiver, this is outside Deal Desk boundaries.

Ask: Can we get senior ratification to approve a 25% one-year discount (applies to first 12 months of invoices), waive the egress surcharge for onboarding, and accept the 30-day termination window conditionally on a signed 24-month minimum commitment? If yes, I need confirmation so I can send an updated proposal to Jordan and loop legal for redlines.

Attachments referenced: MedTech_Proposal_Q3.pdf, SOW-draft.docx. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/view

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior ratification for Hosted API concessions and term change - MedTech AI

Monica —

Thanks for the concise summary and the model. High level thoughts:
- Approving >20% is strictly a senior decision (you know that). I can support up to 20% from my desk.
- The surcharge waiver is small in P&L terms for the onboarding period; main concern is setting precedent.
- The 30-day termination window is the bigger legal risk — it reduces our ability to manage ramp reversals. If they sign 24 months, that mitigates some risk, but Legal needs to weigh in on the termination language and any exposure.

Before I escalate, can you send the ARR ladder and a simple net-present-value line that shows revenue retention if they churn after month 6 vs continue to month 24? If the upside to references/partner intros materially increases CAC payback, that helps the case.

If you can get Tessa and Karthik to back the numbers, I will take to the pricing committee and push for senior signoff.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior ratification for Hosted API concessions and term change - MedTech AI

Tessa / Karthik —

Attached the deal_math.xlsx with two scenarios: conservative churn (20% drop-off after month 6) and ideal retention (steady ramp to 24 months). Key lines:
- Conservative: first 12 months net revenue after 25% discount = $1.35M; payback on our onboarding investment ~ 8 months.
- Ideal: 24-month realized revenue = $4.2M net, with three named reference clinics included in the SOW.

I pushed Jordan on the 30-day termination (they initially requested 30 days). They said 30-day window is a must for one of their investor carve-outs. They are OK moving to 45 days if we hold firm; I have asked whether they will accept 45 if we make the egress waiver time-boxed to first 60 days.

I also confirmed with Ops that we can support the initial traffic pattern on Hosted with explicit routing to us-west-2; they'd like the data-residency addendum in place prior to go-live. Legal will need to scope that addendum but indicated it's straightforward.

Attachments: deal_math.xlsx (P&L scenarios).

If both of you can confirm support for the commercial structure (25% discount conditional on an 18–24 month commitment and confirmation that Legal will sign the residency addendum), I will prepare an exec summary for Ben to take to the pricing committee.

Monica
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior ratification for Hosted API concessions and term change - MedTech AI

Monica —

Appreciate the modeling and the clarity on the non-standard items. After reviewing the numbers and speaking with Legal (Laura), I'm comfortable ratifying the following conditional approval:

- Approve a 25% discount off Hosted API list price for the first 12 months (applies to invoice tokens), conditional on a signed 18-month minimum commitment with a graduated ramp schedule as defined in the attached SOW.
- Waive the egress surcharge for onboarding for up to 60 days only (explicitly time-boxed in the SOW).
- Accept a 45-day termination window (compromise between their 30 and our 60) instead of 30 days.
- Require Legal to execute the data-residency addendum and confirm operational controls to enforce us-west-2 routing before go-live.

Laura has reviewed the proposed termination language and will produce redlines; Legal will also add a clause limiting the precedent: this concession is limited to deal_id MEDTECH-2027-06-A1 and must not be used as template language elsewhere.

Ben — please take this bundle to the pricing committee / exec for formal sign-off. Monica — please update the proposal and send DocuSign links to Jordan; loop Legal for the final redline pass.

Karthik
Chief Revenue Officer (acting)
Redwood Inference
